instruction: Look at gui_007_pipe_elbow.step in SolidWorks, a 90 degree pipe elbow with outer diameter 30 mm, inner diameter 20 mm, flat ends, and a quarter-circle bend path in the XZ plane with nominal bend radius 45 mm. For this workflow, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_007_pipe_elbow.step`. One straight end has its axis along Z and its flat end face centered at (0,0,0); the other straight end has its axis along X and its flat end face centered at (0,0,90). Add one circular flange to each pipe end. Each flange must have outside diameter 58 mm, thickness 8 mm, a center hole matching the 20 mm pipe inner diameter, and four equally spaced through bolt holes of diameter 6 mm on radius 22 mm. Place the flange on the Z-axis end from Z=-8 to Z=0, and place the flange on the X-axis end from X=0 to X=8. The flanges must be coaxial with the elbow ends. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_007_elbow_flanges_out.step as either a single multi-body STEP or an assembly STEP.
